Counterpoint Research 發表咗一份新報告，研究 iPhone Duo 對摺疊式智能手機市場、顯示面板供應商以及該類別至 2030 年增長嘅影響。以下係詳情。

Apple to Capture 27% of 2026 Foldable Panel Shipments

Counterpoint Research yesterday published a new report outlining expectations for the iPhone Duo's performance through the end of 2026, broadly aligning with TrendForce's earlier outlook.

Counterpoint notes that, although the iPhone Duo won't go on sale until next month, Apple is projected to capture 27% of foldable smartphone panel shipments in 2026.

Meanwhile, Samsung is expected to retain its leading position with a 33% market share, with shipments growing 8% year-over-year. Huawei is forecast to rank third with a 25% share, trailing Apple by two percentage points, with shipments declining 6%.

Looking further ahead, Counterpoint projects that foldable panel shipments will grow 74% between 2026 and 2030, 'equivalent to a compound annual growth rate of roughly 15%.'

The report states that 'Apple's shipments are projected to grow 167% from their second-half 2026 base through 2030, lifting the brand's market share by approximately 15 percentage points to 42%'; Samsung's shipments are expected to grow 27%, but its market share will fall to 24%. For Huawei, shipments are projected to grow just 3%, with market share slipping to 15%.
